source: US Census Bureau geocoder, geographies/coordinates, benchmark Public_AR_Current, vintage Current_Current, layers Incorporated Places + Census Designated Places + Counties. Queried 2026-11-11.
rule: scripts/lib/localityEvidence.mjs censusLocality(): the incorporated place containing the point, else the Census-designated place, else none (county only). Written only where locality AND county were both empty (localityIsFillable). metro, coordinates, status and every other column untouched.

normalized.why: matches the 2 rows already stored as Islamorada; a comma is not a city name

held_not_written.reason: Census place is Bay Lake (the Walt Disney World city). Real, but not the name visitors use; held for an owner call on the public city (postal_city).

skipped_not_florida.reason: Census puts the point outside Florida (state FIPS is not 12).
